name: Video Pages
description: Video Pages turns a video you generated or uploaded into a branded landing page with a call-to-action, a lead form and analytics. Each page has a public link of the form /p/<slug>.
shortDescription: Turn a video into a shareable landing page with a button, a lead form and stats.
fullDescription: Video Pages is a studio for building one page around one video. You pick a video (one you made in another SmartVideo studio or one you upload), choose a page template, set your branding and text, and publish to get a public link. Pages can carry a call-to-action, a lead form and analytics, and can be shown per contact with personalised text tokens such as first name and company. Unpublished pages are drafts only you can see.
bestFor: Anyone who wants a simple page for a single video, with a way to capture leads and see how it performs.
whenToUse: You want a shareable page for a video instead of just a file.
You want to collect leads from people who watch the video.
You want a personal link for each contact.
You want to see views and activity for a page.
whenToUseAnother: To build a whole multi-page website, use the Website Builder.
To edit the video itself first, use Timeline or Workbench.
To publish the video straight to YouTube, TikTok or Instagram, use the Publish tab of the Timeline editor.
keyFeatures: Pages built from a video you generated or uploaded
Branding (taken from your first saved brand when you have one)
Public link at /p/<slug> and an embed code
Personal links per contact using text tokens
AI help to rewrite the page text
Optional sync of contacts to your MailerLite account (you bring your own token)
howToUse: 1. Open Video Pages from the Agents group in the side menu (#/video-pages). 2. Pick a video or upload one. 3. Choose a template and fill in your headline, text, button and branding. 4. Preview the page. 5. Publish to get the link, and copy the link or the embed code.
howToSteps: Open Video Pages from the side menu.
Choose a video from your generations, or upload a file.
Pick a template and edit the page text, button and branding.
Check the preview. A page stays a draft, visible only to you, until you publish it.
Publish, then copy the page link or the embed code.
Add contacts if you want a personal link for each person.
gettingStarted: Sign in: pages are saved to your account.
Start from a template, then change the text.
inputs: A video (from your generations or an upload)
limitations: You need to be signed in to save and publish pages.
Uploaded videos have a size limit.
Sending contacts to MailerLite needs your own MailerLite token.
Sending contacts to Kit from this studio is not available.
troubleshooting: If a page does not open for other people, check that it is published and not a draft.
If saving fails, check that you are signed in.
If an upload is rejected, try a smaller file.

faqs.question: Who can see my page?
faqs.answer: Only you, until you publish it. After that anyone with the link can.

faqs.question: Can each contact get their own link?
faqs.answer: Yes, add contacts to the page and each one gets a personal link that fills in tokens like first name and company.

faqs.question: Is there a way to send contacts to my email tool?
faqs.answer: The page can push contacts to your own MailerLite account with your own token. It does not send email itself.
